Get insights based on the contents of your climate profile.

params.description: If you want to display heading of the insights content

params.description: size of page upto which data should be present

params.description: Page number of the page whose data should be present in response

params.description: language in which user wants to see insights to their climate profile

items.docs: The Insights service delivers insights and other suggestions that can inform you about what you can do to reduce your footprint.
